svg.text: A flat plate 37.5 x 71 x 2 mm, printed flat.

svg.text: Four 2.2 mm holes, 4 mm in from each end and 34.5 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre line, over the four tray posts in the pack base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay out the boards on top (stick them on with double-sided foam tape):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rear row, from the thumb side: charger (USB-C port to the rear wall),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: controller, driver 1; front row: battery board, driver 2.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: rests on the four posts, 1 mm above the cells, with a 1 mm foam

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pad between; four M2.2 self-tapping screws hold it and the cells.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the charger's USB-C port lines up with the rear wall opening.
